name: threat-intel-toolkit
description: Defensive IOC + vulnerability triage on free/open-source intel: a subagent plus two skills — threat-intel-lookup (aggregates 10 key-free feeds and looks up IPs, domains, URLs, CVEs) and exploit-availability-check (rates a CVE's exploit/PoC maturity via KEV, EPSS, Metasploit, Nuclei, Exploit-DB, and PoC aggregators). No API keys required.
